entries.description: List of client boot entries, each defining how a specific host should boot.

hostname.description: Hostname (or MAC address prefix like 08:00:2B) of the client to match.

kernel.description: Path to the kernel image (relative to TFTP root or absolute).

initrd.description: Path to the initial RAM disk image (optional). Leave empty to omit.

root_path.description: Root filesystem path — e.g., NFS mount (format: server:/path) or local path.
